name: tier1-mcts-v0-sf-leaf
notes: Phase 0 bakeoff: identical to tier1-mcts-v0 (MCTS, 200 rollouts, depth-8 rollout, depth-3 selection, CVaR 0.25) but swaps leaf evaluator from fow to depth-1 Stockfish (Obscuro-style). Tests whether Stockfish-as-leaf > fow_evaluator-as-leaf inside the same PIMC scaffold. Uniform prior on both sides to keep eval the only variable.
